    - heading "Amazon S3" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Store and retrieve any amount of data from anywhere to power your analytics, applications, and AI workloads.
    - button "Get started with S3"
    - button "View user guide"
    - heading "What is Amazon S3?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is a fully managed object storage service for storing and retrieving any amount of data at any scale. It offers industry-leading durability, availability, security, and performance, serving millions of customers who build data lakes, cloud-native applications, and AI workloads on AWS.
    - button "Play:"
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "How much does S3 cost?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Try S3 for free
    - paragraph: New AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits, which can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon S3. The free plan is available for 6 months after account creation.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Learn more about the AWS Free Tier":
        - /url: /free/?p=pdp&c=s3&s=3
    - paragraph: Pay as you go
    - paragraph: Pay only for the storage, requests, and data transfer you use with no upfront commitment.
    - paragraph:
      - link "View detailed pricing":
        - /url: /s3/pricing/?p=pdp&c=s3&s=3
    - heading "What problems does S3 solve?" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - heading "Data loss and downtime risk" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_cloud_11_1200"
    - text: S3 protects data without manual replication management, delivering 99.999999999% (11 nines) durability and 99.99% availability by default. Both figures are backed by the strongest SLAs in the cloud.
    - heading "Storage capacity planning and provisioning" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_data_14_1200"
    - text: S3 stores virtually any amount of data, scaling to exabytes without provisioning storage in advance. It grows and shrinks automatically as you add and remove data, so you pay only for what you use with no capacity planning required.
    - heading "Rising storage costs across access patterns" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_cloud_1_1200"
    - text: S3 optimizes spend without manual data movement through multiple storage classes and automated lifecycle management. S3 Intelligent-Tiering has saved customers more than $6 billion in storage costs.
    - heading "Slow access for critical workloads" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_connect_11_1200"
    - text: S3 Express One Zone accelerates demanding workloads without compromising scale, delivering consistent single-digit millisecond latency and up to 10x faster data access than S3 Standard. This lowers API request costs and total cost of ownership.
    - heading "How does S3 work?" [level=2]
    - heading "1. Create a bucket" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - link "Create a bucket":
        - /url: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/GetStartedWithS3.html?refid=ft_s3#creating-bucket
      - text: in your chosen AWS Region. S3 provisions durable, elastic storage that scales automatically as your data grows.
    - heading "2. Upload objects" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Upload objects through the
      - link "console":
        - /url: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/home?refid=ft_s3
      - text: ", API, or SDKs. S3 stores each object with 11 nines durability and encrypts it by default."
    - heading "3. Choose a storage class" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Choose a storage class or enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering. S3 matches cost to access pattern and moves data automatically to optimize spend.
    - heading "4. Retrieve or query data" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Retrieve or query data from analytics, applications, or AI services. S3 integrates directly with AWS analytics and AI/ML services for a fast path from data to intelligence.
    - heading "What are the top S3 use cases?" [level=2]
    - link "Data lakes and analytics S3 provides the foundation for petabyte-scale data lakes with support for open table formats like Apache Iceberg. Learn more":

      - text: Learn more

      - heading "Generative AI and agentic applications" [level=3]
      - paragraph: S3 delivers a durable, scalable foundation to train, fine-tune, and ground models across structured, unstructured, streaming, and vector data. Grendene builds generative AI applications on Amazon S3.
      - text: Read the case study
    - link "High-performance workloads S3 Express One Zone accelerates AI training, real-time analytics, and media processing with single-digit millisecond latency. Learn more":
